target.name: Nova the Optimal AI Free 3.0.0
target.candidate_state: clean source checkpoint plus post-checkpoint verification evidence

constraints: archive digests pre-exist TestForge and are not a TestForge seal
post-checkpoint evidence dirt does not alter product source
safety_boundary: local read-only inspection and temporary test mutations only
no user-state, hosted, paid, publication, or external action

observed.statement: The frozen source and final package contain one plugin, the Nova front door, 25 visible roots, MIND 0.2.0, and 16 nested Faculty Cores.
observed.basis: product contract, loadout, E-001 and E-002

observed.statement: The builder recorded checkpoint 6151da1 as clean and no non-verification path differs from it.
The local suite passed 22 tests; the extracted-package oracle passed with 131 customer references checked.
The maintained-doc checker passed 16 documents and 13 local references; the site checker passed 11 pages.
Public redistribution is blocked by absent grants for six included components and two metadata reconciliations.
Manual GitHub workflows were not dispatched and current private-repository capacity was not observed.
No publication or external release action was authorized or performed.
observed.basis: task authority and local execution record

inferred.statement: The checkpoint is locally qualified for composition, packaging, core state behavior, and static customer-package readiness on the exercised Windows boundary.
Adversarial tests materially reduce silent acceptance of missing skills, host drift, broken references, forbidden state fallback, and false redistribution readiness.

assumed.statement: The repository source lock and map accurately identify canonical imports and overlays.
assumed.basis: maintained custody records and source-lock regression; remotes not refreshed by this operator

assumed.statement: The component-rights audit controls until explicit grants supersede it.
assumed.basis: No contrary grant supplied; audit is not legal counsel.

unresolved.statement: Fresh-host install, discovery, restart, invocation, and rollback are unobserved.
Hosted runner, matrix, and account-capacity evidence is absent.
Keyboard, screen-reader, all-page responsive, external-link, and representative-user checks remain bounded conditions.
Real-world efficacy across all 25 roots was not exercised.

impact_map: Custody affects provenance and redistribution rights.
Build parity affects delivered bytes and rollback.
Estate policy affects privacy and recoverability.
Documentation parity affects install, upgrade, support, security, and license understanding.
Rights, fresh-host, hosted-provider, and publication gates are independent.

invariants.statement: Exactly one Nova plugin exposes 25 visible roots and 16 nested MIND cores.
Imports and persona match the lock; protected Agent Swarm and TestForge roots have no edition overlay.
Repeated builds match and Codex/Claude skill bytes are identical.
Ordinary use requires no Python, Ollama, embeddings, vector DB, hook, daemon, or estate.
Optional state uses four Free selectors, never .codex, preserves but does not inject extras, and fails atomically.
Customer docs retain executable journeys and the blocked redistribution state.
Hosted, paid, publication, and external actions require separate authority.

risks.statement: Absent component rights permit an unauthorized public distribution.
False ready metadata can hide the rights blocker.
Topology drift exposes the wrong product.
Custody drift or protected-root edits break provenance and the unchanged-work basis.
Nondeterminism or host drift delivers unreviewed bytes.
State fallback, retired-selector injection, or partial init violates custody or recovery.
Source/package documentation drift gives customers broken or unsafe journeys.
Static success may hide fresh-host binding failures.
Local Windows evidence may be overclaimed as hosted cross-platform evidence.
A moving source tree invalidates earlier observations.
Package evidence may be overclaimed as outcome efficacy for every specialist.
Publication under build-only authority exposes an unlicensed candidate.

scenarios.title: All included components have compatible redistribution rights
action: Audit each component's rights and metadata.
expected: Every root has a compatible basis and metadata agrees.
forbidden: Treat a notice as a grant

scenarios.title: False ready metadata is rejected
action: Change only redistribution_state to ready and run the verifier.
expected: FAIL identifies loss of the blocker.

scenarios.title: Topology and source custody match the contract
preconditions: Contract, loadout, lock, source, and package exist.
action: Run source-lock/topology tests and package oracle.
expected: One plugin, 25 roots, 16 cores, persona and imports match.

scenarios.title: Repeated builds and host packages preserve content
preconditions: Frozen source and temporary outputs exist.
action: Build twice, compare archives and host skill trees, verify inventory.
expected: Builds match; host skill bytes are identical; inventories are exact.

scenarios.title: Optional state stays external and recoverable
preconditions: Nova Operations and temporary fake services exist.
action: Exercise init, upgrade, status, doctor, injection, absence, path, and failure.
expected: Four selectors only; no .codex fallback; extras not injected; init failure is atomic.

scenarios.title: Source and package retain safe customer journeys
preconditions: Repaired docs, 11-page site, and rebuilt package exist.
action: Check Markdown, deployed-site boundary, pages, renders, task journey, and package references.
expected: Install, invocation, upgrade/rollback, support, security, and rights routes resolve; 131 package references pass.

scenarios.title: Clean hosts install and invoke Nova
preconditions: Disposable Codex and Claude-compatible hosts exist.
action: Install, discover, restart, invoke, and roll back.
expected: Nova is discovered and works through its front door; rollback restores prior binding.

scenarios.title: GitHub three-OS matrix runs the checkpoint
preconditions: Fresh allowance snapshot and dispatch authority exist.
action: Dispatch one three-job workflow with no retry.
expected: All jobs run and provider integration reports correctly.

scenarios.title: Evidence remains bound to checkpoint 6151da1
preconditions: Checkpoint and final package manifest exist.
action: Compare all non-verification paths to the checkpoint.
expected: No product/source path differs and build records the same clean checkpoint.

scenarios.title: Representative specialist workflows meet domain oracles
preconditions: Representative tasks and domain oracles exist.
action: Exercise representative specialist and reviewer workflows.
expected: Outputs meet domain oracles without state leakage.

scenarios.title: Release actions require separate authority
action: Inspect controls and do not invoke external actions.
expected: No push, tag, release, deploy, submission, distribution, or announcement.

command: NOT RUN: manual GitHub Actions three-OS workflow_dispatch

findings.statement: Six included components lack supplied redistribution grants and two metadata sets conflict with a public Free claim.
findings.next_action: Obtain explicit grants, reconcile metadata, and rerun all gates against the resulting revision.

findings.statement: Fresh-host installation and behavior are unobserved.
findings.next_action: Run full customer journeys on disposable Codex and Claude-compatible hosts.

findings.statement: Hosted cross-platform/provider evidence is absent because capacity is unknown and dispatch unauthorized.
findings.next_action: Obtain a fresh capacity snapshot and authority, or run a bounded clean/self-hosted substitute.

findings.statement: Package qualification does not establish efficacy across all 25 roots.
findings.next_action: Run representative behavior qualification with domain oracles.

residual_risks.treatment: Keep claim static/local; require clean-host execution.

residual_risks.statement: Real-world efficacy across all skills is unproved.
